INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information.

2. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

6. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

7. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

10. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading Comprehension: Reading Strategies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
